verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no downloadable machine-readable API spec for Sketch. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The JavaScript API docs, the sketchtool CLI, the built-in MCP server and the JSON-based .sketch file format are related features, but none is a published OpenAPI-or-equivalent API specification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
